svg.title: Reserving what the running schedule uses
svg.desc: Animated: Plan() marks every AGV, node, bay and VECS used by base_schedule as disabled, builds the keep-out filters once, and every later stage avoids those assets; both schedules then run side by side.
svg.metadata: ["base_state, the snapshot Dispatch sends: AGV-2 is lifted under T15 at P15, AGV-1 is idle at W26, AGV-3 is idle at W13, empty tray T24 is at P24 and loaded tray T17 at P17.", "base_schedule: every action of Dispatch's schedule that is not completed yet. a1 moves AGV-2 P15 -> P19, a2 moves it P19 -> P23 (carrying T15), a3 lowers T15 at P23, b1 sends B21 TRANSITION_TO_RETRIEVE. The scheduler must assume all of them complete.", "ExcludeCommittedResources in Plan() reserves what they use: AGV-2 is disabled; P15, P19 and P23 (every source and destination) and B21 go into disabled_nodes_; bay B21 is disabled. The snapshot is not advanced: in initial_state AGV-2 is still at P15.", "BuildKeepOutFilters builds the keep-out map once. Per footprint, a vertex or edge is off if it collides with a reserved entity, an entity standing on a reserved node, or a reserved node's largest window at any heading. Free AGVs and trays are ignored here: they may move.", "Pending job j0, MOVE_AGV AGV-2 -> C14: ExpandAgvMoveJob reads agvs_[2].disabled and fails the job with \"Tried to move a disabled agv 2\". The message cannot tell a busy AGV from one taken out of service.", "Pending job j1, REPARK_TRAY T24 -> P20: P20 is on in the TRAY keep-out filter, so a TrayMove T24 -> P20 is added to the event DAG.", "AssignAgvs offers only AGV-1 and AGV-3; AGV-2 is skipped. AGV-1 gets the move. CHUGG's GetMovableAgvs skips AGV-2 too: it stays a static obstacle at P15 and the reserved nodes stay blocked for the whole new plan.", "Execution. Dispatch keeps running a1 and a2 (AGV-2 carries T15 to P23) while the new plan starts: AGV-1 drives W26 -> W27 -> P24 and lifts T24. The two schedules share no AGV, bay or reserved node, so no edge joins them.", "AGV-1 carries T24 to P20 and lowers it. AGV-2 was unavailable to the new plan from start to end, even though its last base action ended early."]

g.text: Reserving what the running schedule uses

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: "Disabled" here means "owned by the running schedule": the new plan routes around those assets for its whole duration. The keep-out overlay shows the rule, not CollisionTable output.
